name: VPS and dev boxes
ownerWords: stop being paranoid in plan under p45, p221. these should be modeled separately, like in a doc tracking all the known vps infra risks and a duty that checks these. ... things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved -> cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: No risk on the infra risk page (wiki domains/ops/infra-risks, its list in duties/01a11af8-962e-773d-a19a-ee4104011987/infra-risks.json) has a Grafana alert rule firing, us-metal01's root disk has at least 30 days left at the last 24 h rate, and all 9 M1 Air runners are online. Tell the owner only when a risk fires with no fix moving it.

metrics.label: Risks on the infra risk page with a Grafana rule firing
Days until us-metal01's root disk is full at the last 24 h rate

onMiss: Fix a source_error first; a gap line means the risk page names a rule Grafana lacks, so fix the page's list or the rule. Each firing line names the risk page line and its owner. For each one add one fix step with duty "<dutyId>/risks_firing" naming that risk, and steer the owner's live job on it, or start one job with rlm.create_session that lands a code change for it (commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name> in auto-sns-agent, or a sieun-pi commit), and set the step's duty, job and sessionId. A risk owned by another thread gets the ask once with the page line, and this chat's fix step tracks its land. root_disk_days under 30: the fix step goes to metal's disk plan (ClickHouse hot/cold to /hdd.raid10, cold PG tables to an HDD tablespace). air_runners_online under 9: read devbox_runner_up by name on obs.virev.ai and bring the missing runner back on the M1 Air. An unchecked line is a risk with no rule; give it a rule through the Grafana alert code. Tell the owner which risks fire and what fixes them. All on target: no message.
